{{Quote|You haven't heard of the great Lord Ferrid? I stole a Republic superweapon and turned it against the miserable cretins. How I cherish the memory.|Lord Ferrid|<ref name="TORRepSec" />}}
Around [[3665 BBY]], during the [[Great Galactic War]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Ferrid]] undertook a '''mission''' to steal a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Ferrid was successful in his quest and managed to turn the weapon on the Republic before being captured by enemy forces and sent to the [[Belsavis prison|maximum security detention facility]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]].<ref name="TORRepSec" />
